evidence_scope: Actual typed DCC-MCP production: geometry, materials, camera, lighting, four Mantra renders, private HIP reopen, and same-Houdini OBJ export/reimport. PNG author metadata removed through adapter-exposed MCP automation with compressed image data and decoded pixels unchanged. A second dedicated empty host completed 47 non-render recipe steps and 49 typed request/response calls; exported OBJ is byte-identical to the first. Production Core/CLI/Gateway0.20.28 and follow-up CLI/Core0.20.28 with observed transitional Gateway0.20.22 are recorded separately. No second full render or anonymous native HIP export is claimed.
reproduction_requirements: Use the recorded Houdini and DCC-MCP versions in a dedicated empty host.
Read recipe preconditions, choose a writable CASE_DIR, use require-gateway and a stable session ID.
Run replay-cli.ps1 with a discovered InstanceId; Render is opt-in.
OBJ does not retain SOP history, materials, lights or the native scene.
Audit native HIP and private CLI logs before any further publication.
integrity_wrapper_scope: This site-side wrapper is excluded from the ZIP to avoid an archive self-hash. The ZIP carries its own member manifest and independently extracted hashes.
